findings.description: SKILL.md and LOOP.md still show `pup answer <session> <n>` / `pup answer conductor …` without the now-required `--question <id>`, so a copied command fails with commander's 'required option not specified'.
findings.body:
**Stale operator guide: `pup answer` now requires `--question <id>`**

This PR makes `--question <id>` a `requiredOption` on `pup answer` (`src/cli/index.ts`, `.requiredOption('--question <id>', …)`), with no positional or fallback alternative. The skill guides the conductor and operator load (README tells users to symlink `skills/pup` into `~/.claude/skills/pup`) still show the old form:

- `skills/pup/SKILL.md:41`: "`pup answer <session> <n>` picks option n of the question Needs you lists … `pup answer <session> "<words>"` answers freely; `pup answer conductor …` answers the conductor's"
- `skills/pup/LOOP.md:114`: "answer it with `pup answer <session> <n>`, or in words."

An agent or operator following either line gets `error: required option '--question <id>' not specified`, and neither says the id is the `question #<id>` the inbox and `pup status` now print. Neither file is in the diff, but this PR's CLI change is what falsified them.

Fix: show `--question <id>` in both places and name where the id comes from.

https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/483d8086b78dbe891915f03d37362d4e431efbfc/skills/pup/SKILL.md#L41-L41
https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/483d8086b78dbe891915f03d37362d4e431efbfc/skills/pup/LOOP.md#L114-L114
findings.suggestion: | Answer a question | `pup answer <session> <n> --question <id>` picks option n of the question Needs you lists (numbered, the recommended one marked; `<id>` is the `question #<id>` it shows, and a newer question refuses the answer); `pup answer <session> "<words>" --question <id>` answers freely; `pup answer conductor … --question <id>` answers the conductor's (operator-only; `pup ui`'s number keys do the same) |

findings.description: `type AnswerWords` is declared inline in a service file and used by both `answerMessage` and `conductorQuestion`; general.md §Code layout puts a reused type in `src/core/types/` (e.g. beside `EventPayloads` in session-event.types.ts).

The call-site comment on `pup conductor ask` ("The run's token is the window's, never the caller's to name…") restates `markConductorQuestion`'s JSDoc; general.md §Comments says a call-site copy of the callee's docs is deleted.
`questionNeed` writes `questionId: question.id` in both its early return and its main return; folding the no-options case into a conditional spread removes the branch and the duplicated field.

The TUI number keys and web dashboard option buttons bind to the question rendered at keypress/click time, so a question a session asks milliseconds before the click (web `flush()` swaps the board under the pointer) gets the same option number; holding the board while the pointer is over an answer form would close it.
